name: Aiyagari1994.two_independent_histories_contradiction
signature:
∀ {E : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace E] (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure E) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure nu]
  (shock : E → ℝ),
  Measurable shock →
    ∀ (B : ℝ),
      0 ≤ B →
        (∀ (e : E), |shock e| ≤ B) →
          (¬∃ a, shock =ᵐ[nu] fun x => a) →
            ∀ (R : ℝ),
              1 < R →
                ∀ (c : NNReal → NNReal),
                  Measurable c →
                    ∀ (step : NNReal → E → NNReal) (hstep : Measurable fun p => step p.1 p.2),
                      (∀ (z : NNReal) (e : E), ↑(step z e) = R * (↑z - ↑(c z)) + shock e) →
                        ∀ (pi : MeasureTheory.Measure NNReal) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure pi],
                          pi.bind ⇑(Aiyagari1994.M07B1.resourceKernel nu step hstep) = pi →
                            (∀ᵐ (zz' : NNReal × NNReal) ∂pi.compProd (Aiyagari1994.M07B1.resourceKernel nu step hstep),
                                c zz'.2 = c zz'.1) →
                              False

signature:
∀ (m : Aiyagari1994.HouseholdPrimitives) (hsmooth : Aiyagari1994.UtilitySmooth m.utility)
  (hcurvature : Aiyagari1994.UtilityCurvature m.utility) (hnd : Aiyagari1994.IncomeNondegenerate m.income)
  (hbetaR : m.beta * m.prices.grossReturn < 1) (p : Aiyagari1994.OriginalPrices m.income),
  m.prices = p.normalized →
    have pi := Aiyagari1994.M06C.stationaryLaw m hsmooth hcurvature hnd hbetaR;
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ↑z) ↑pi ∧
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ↑(Aiyagari1994.assetPolicy m z)) ↑pi ∧
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ↑(Aiyagari1994.assetPolicy m z) - p.debtLimit) ↑pi ∧
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ↑(Aiyagari1994.consumptionPolicy m z)) ↑pi ∧
            MeasureTheory.Integrable m.prices.effectiveIncome ↑m.income.law ∧
              ∫ (z : Aiyagari1994.Resources), ↑z ∂↑pi =
                  m.prices.grossReturn * ∫ (z : Aiyagari1994.Resources), ↑(Aiyagari1994.assetPolicy m z) ∂↑pi +
                    ∫ (l : ↑(Aiyagari1994.Labor m.income.lower m.income.upper)),
                      m.prices.effectiveIncome l ∂↑m.income.law ∧
                Aiyagari1994.stationaryAssetSupply m p.debtLimit pi =
                    ∫ (z : Aiyagari1994.Resources), ↑(Aiyagari1994.assetPolicy m z) ∂↑pi - p.debtLimit ∧
                  ∫ (z : Aiyagari1994.Resources), ↑(Aiyagari1994.consumptionPolicy m z) ∂↑pi =
                    p.netRate * Aiyagari1994.stationaryAssetSupply m p.debtLimit pi +

signature:
∀ {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (k : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b) ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b))
  [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel k]
  (hFeller :
    ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b) ℝ),
      Continuous fun x => ∫ (y : ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b)), f y ∂k x),
  (∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b) ℝ),
      Monotone ⇑f → Monotone fun x => ∫ (y : ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b)), f y ∂k x) →
    ∀ (d : ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b)) (N : ℕ),
      1 ≤ N →
        ∀ (eps : ℝ),
          0 < eps →
            eps ≤ 1 →
              (∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b) ℝ),
                  Monotone ⇑f →
                    eps * f d + (1 - eps) * f ⟨a, ⋯⟩ ≤ ((Aiyagari1994.testStep k hFeller)^[N] f) ⟨a, ⋯⟩ ∧
                      ((Aiyagari1994.testStep k hFeller)^[N] f) ⟨b, ⋯⟩ ≤ eps * f d + (1 - eps) * f ⟨b, ⋯⟩) →
                (∃! pi,
                    Aiyagari1994.lawStep k pi = pi ∧
                      ∀ (mu : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b)),
                        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (Aiyagari1994.lawStep k)^[n] mu) Filter.atTop (nhds pi)) ∧
                  ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b) ℝ),
                    Monotone ⇑f →
                      ∀ (m : ℕ),
                        ((Aiyagari1994.testStep k hFeller)^[N]^[m] f) ⟨b, ⋯⟩ -
                            ((Aiyagari1994.testStep k hFeller)^[N]^[m] f) ⟨a, ⋯⟩ ≤
                          (1 - eps) ^ m * (f ⟨b, ⋯⟩ - f ⟨a, ⋯⟩)

  [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel k]
  (hFeller :
    ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b) ℝ),
      Continuous fun x => ∫ (y : ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b)), f y ∂k x),
  (∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b) ℝ),
      Monotone ⇑f → Monotone fun x => ∫ (y : ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b)), f y ∂k x) →
    ∀ (d : ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b)) (N : ℕ),
      1 ≤ N →
        ∀ (eps : ℝ),
          0 < eps →
            eps ≤ 1 →
              (∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b) ℝ),
                  Monotone ⇑f →
                    eps * f d + (1 - eps) * f ⟨a, ⋯⟩ ≤ ((Aiyagari1994.testStep k hFeller)^[N] f) ⟨a, ⋯⟩ ∧
                      ((Aiyagari1994.testStep k hFeller)^[N] f) ⟨b, ⋯⟩ ≤ eps * f d + (1 - eps) * f ⟨b, ⋯⟩) →
                (∃! pi,
                    Aiyagari1994.lawStep k pi = pi ∧
                      ∀ (mu : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b)),
                        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (Aiyagari1994.lawStep k)^[n] mu) Filter.atTop (nhds pi)) ∧
                  ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction ↑(Aiyagari1994.CI a b) ℝ),
                    Monotone ⇑f →
                      ∀ (m : ℕ),
                        ((Aiyagari1994.testStep k hFeller)^[N]^[m] f) ⟨b, ⋯⟩ -
                            ((Aiyagari1994.testStep k hFeller)^[N]^[m] f) ⟨a, ⋯⟩ ≤
                          (1 - eps) ^ m * (f ⟨b, ⋯⟩ - f ⟨a, ⋯⟩)

name: Aiyagari1994.uniform_upper_drift
signature:
∀ (m : Aiyagari1994.HouseholdPrimitives),
  Aiyagari1994.UtilitySmooth m.utility →
    Aiyagari1994.UtilityCurvature m.utility →
      ∀ (Q : Set (Aiyagari1994.AdmissibleNormalizedPrices m.income)) (Rmin Rmax gammaStar EStar DeltaStar : ℝ),
        0 < Rmin →
          0 < Rmax →
            gammaStar < 1 →
              0 ≤ EStar →
                0 ≤ DeltaStar →
                  (∀ q ∈ Q,
                      Rmin ≤ q.grossReturn ∧
                        q.grossReturn ≤ Rmax ∧
                          m.beta * q.grossReturn ≤ gammaStar ∧
                            Aiyagari1994.M04CIncomeUpper m q ≤ EStar ∧
                              Aiyagari1994.M04CIncomeUpper m q - Aiyagari1994.M04CIncomeLower m q ≤ DeltaStar) →
                    ∃ B,
                      0 < B ∧
                        ∀ q ∈ Q,
                          Aiyagari1994.M04CIncomeUpper m q ≤ B ∧
                            (∀ (z : Aiyagari1994.Resources),
                                B ≤ ↑z →
                                  q.grossReturn * ↑(Aiyagari1994.assetPolicy (m.withPrices q) z) +
                                      Aiyagari1994.M04CIncomeUpper m q ≤
                                    ↑z) ∧
                              ∀ (z : Aiyagari1994.Resources),
                                Aiyagari1994.M04CIncomeLower m q ≤ ↑z →
                                  ↑z ≤ B →
                                    ∀ (l : ↑m.income.Labor),
                                      Aiyagari1994.M04CIncomeLower m q ≤
                                          ↑(q.toPrices.nextResources (Aiyagari1994.assetPolicy (m.withPrices q) z) l) ∧
                                        ↑(q.toPrices.nextResources (Aiyagari1994.assetPolicy (m.withPrices q) z) l) ≤ B
